config.label: RIGShare API key (Bearer format)
config.description: RIGShare API key (Bearer format). Required only for the authenticated tools: rigshare_list_my_bookings, rigshare_list_my_sessions, rigshare_create_booking. Without it, the four public read-only tools still work. Get a key at https://www.rigshare.app/profile#api-keys or contact support@rigshare.app.
